pairs.subject: workflow-property-contracts
pairs.evidence: lib/ingest/sources/monitor.ts:1 These adapters are open-data clients and parsers, not a training or inference workflow that a third-party host drives by property name; I searched lib/ingest/sources/ and lib, features, scripts and packages for epoch, trainer, check_properties, required_properties and EPOCH_COMPLETED and got zero hits, so there is no property table, contract check or training-loop event seam for the subject to govern.

techniques.evidence: lib/ingest/sources/monitor.ts:1 No workflow kind exposes a required/optional property table; the module is a fetch client plus parsers.
lib/ingest/sources/monitor.ts:228 The only loop is an HTTP retry loop; there are no forward/loss/backward stages publishing named events.
lib/ingest/sources/smlouvy.ts:1 These are adapters over external registries, not hosts (federated client, candidate generator, annotation tool) driving workflows they did not author.
lib/ingest/sources/isvz.ts:143 Plain parse functions returning typed records; no component is read or set by name through a property table.
lib/ingest/sources/kiosek-pdf.ts:24 No config-backed workflow and code-first workflow implement one contract side by side.
lib/ingest/sources/monitor.ts:1 No optional components with reference locations in a workflow graph to verify.
